messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

message.reasoning:
The question asks: "When did Atlas take over feature-flags?"

Let me trace the ownership history of feature-flags:
- 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06: Atlas owns it
- 2025-11-06: ownership transferred from Atlas to Ember (Ember owns it from 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11)
- 2026-02-11: ownership transferred from Ember to Dune (per the earlier entry, valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09)
- Correction (2026-03-09): As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by Atlas team; ownership transferred from Ember on that date. Valid 2026-03-09 to now.

So the corrected version says: as of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by Atlas, transferred from Ember on that date (2026-02-11).

So Atlas took over feature-flags on 2026-02-11 (from Ember), per the correction.

The question asks "When did Atlas take over feature-flags?" — the answer is 2026-02-11.

Note: Atlas originally owned it from 2025-01-08, but the "take over" event per the correction is 2026-02-11 when ownership transferred from Ember to Atlas.

Answer: 2026-02-11.
